entities.name: Johann von Götzen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann von Götzen, known as Johann von Götz, was a Lüneburg nobleman and Generalfeldmarschall who fought during the Thirty Years' War. He was married to Elisabeth of the Falke family, with whom he had two sons: Johann Sigismund, Count of Götzen (1622–1622) and Johann Georg, Count of Götzen (1623–1679).

entities.summary: Johann von Götzen, known as Johann von Götz, was a Lüneburg nobleman and Generalfeldmarschall who fought during the Thirty Years' War. He was married to Elisabeth of the Falke family, with whom he had two sons: Johann Sigismund, Count of Götzen (1622–1622) and Johann Georg, Count of Götzen (1623–1679).
